card.name: Words just before year, week or daily
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "the", "twice" or "times" where the next word is likely a time unit like year, week or daily. Seen in phrases like "Word of the Year", "this time of year" and "divided into twice daily doses".

modes.label: Of in set phrases
modes.description: The word "of" (or "the") in titles and seasonal phrases that end in year or week.
modes.example: (referring to the year 2000) became an heavily used buzzword in German media, so that it was chosen as German Word<< of>> the Year by the Gesellschaft für deutsche

modes.label: Dose frequency words
modes.description: "twice" or "times" in dosing schedules that are followed by "daily".

card.writes: It lowers the odds of year, week and day coming next, so the model avoids a time unit and favors other continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the small word right before an expected time unit like year or daily, and pushes the model away from writing that unit.
